name: Long March 6A
location_str: LC-9A @ Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: 9 launches from LC-9A so far this year. 28 in total since it opened.
slot_b_text: The 47th launch of the year for China's CASC, 617th all time. 9th from LC-9A this year, 30 days since the last one. The 230th orbital launch attempt worldwide this year. Long March 6A is on a 26-flight success streak.
rocket_fact: Rockets are mostly fuel; often over 85% of a launch vehicle's mass is propellant, leaving little room for payload.
